_comment: Written by Phase 0. Every value here is measured, not estimated. See bench/results/ and PHASE0.md.

gpu._mode_rationale: The narrator is cloud-hosted, so no LLM ever occupies this GPU. ComfyUI keeps it to itself and the broker's handoff machinery is inert — it stays only as a guard rail (foreign-job detection, headroom check, idle eviction).
gpu._worst_case: LLM loaded while ComfyUI idles. At num_ctx 4096 this is ~10967 MiB, leaving ~1321 MiB headroom.
gpu._min_headroom: Broker refuses to load the LLM below this and frees ComfyUI first. Below this we are in untested territory; E7's 461 MiB did survive, so this is conservative, not a cliff.

image._checkpoint: SDXL-based anime model. GPU is free now that the narrator is cloud.
image._size: SDXL native portrait. 1216 tall suits character shots and phone screens.

portrait._why: One reference portrait per character, generated from their frozen appearance. Scene images of that character then run PuLID against the portrait so the face stays the same between scenes.

pulid._why: PuLID for SDXL, already installed with insightface. Applied only to scenes that include a character who has a reference portrait.

image._sampling: MEASURED, do not change without re-testing: v1.1 is eps-prediction. v1.1 + v_prediction renders uniform grey. The alternative checkpoint noobaiXLNAIXL_vPred10Version.safetensors needs sampling='v_prediction' and gives deeper contrast at ~50% more time (33.6s vs 22.7s). The user's saved workflows set v_prediction on v1.1, which is incorrect.
image._params: CFG 5-6, 25-30 steps, Euler a — Laxhar's recommended range, matching the user's tests.
image._prompting: No prompt text lives here. The quality stack, tag order, shot pool, negatives, per-rating content clauses and the portrait template are all in prompting.toml, re-read on every image. NoobAI wants danbooru TAGS, not prose - a CLIP encoder renders sentences flat and generic.

llm._model: Probed against mistral-large-4, glm-5.3, kimi-k3 and muse-spark-open. deepseek engaged on every probe including adult content, fastest at 5-6s, and returns 200-260 words unprompted. muse-spark-open was the only refusal.
llm._num_predict: Must clear the reasoning phase. These models emit `reasoning` before `content`; too small a cap returns empty content with finish_reason=length, which looks exactly like a refusal.
llm._budget: Measured $0.00148/turn warm, 20x headroom. Cached input is 30x cheaper than fresh, so the system prompt must stay byte-identical across turns or every turn pays full price. Per-turn state goes in the user message.

tuning_notes.steps: E3 measured linear scaling: ~1s fixed + 1.7s/step at 1024x1024. 12 steps costs 0.62x of 20. Images at 8/12/16/20 with a fixed seed are in ComfyUI/output/ for visual comparison - lower this once a human confirms quality holds.
tuning_notes.resolution: E4: 768x768 21.9s/9157 MiB peak; 768x1152 30.4s/9958; 1024x1024 35.2s/10456. 768x768 chosen for VRAM headroom, but it is square, which suits story illustration less well than a portrait frame. 768x1152 is affordable if headroom proves comfortable in practice.
tuning_notes.cache_hazard: ComfyUI serves an identical workflow from cache instantly. Any benchmark or retry MUST vary the seed or it silently reports a fake 0s generation. This bug bit twice during Phase 0 (E5 and E7).
